title: How to write an Atlas domain
tagline: A short example domain that teaches the domain-pack format by using it.
audience: Domain experts and designers who want to write or review a domain for Atlas.
notices: This is an example domain. It shows every part of the format, so contributors can see how a lesson looks before writing their own.

objectives.short: How a domain pack is organized
Writing a lesson that passes review

weeks.title: Writing a domain pack
weeks.outcome: Explain how a domain pack is organized and write a lesson that passes the automated checks and expert review.

modules.title: Authoring
modules.security: The domain-pack format, the build checks and the review process.
modules.design: Every lesson pairs domain knowledge with a product design layer.
